title: When adding a string with another string, a new object is created
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.4.1 Stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6614) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

I noticed that the amount of objects in godot increases when adding two string variables in a rich text label together which I find slightly odd. This is even if I keep adding the SAME string to the rich text label's text. I noticed that the amount of objects in my scene was increasing without any reason while I was making my project, and after trial and error I found out this strange quirk.

In the MRP I provided down bellow, I have a button, a text label, and a simple script which creates a variable called froggers, and sets the text of rich text label, to the text of rich text label + froggers, over and over again 5000 times per button press. When I press the button, my project goes from 1367 objects, to 6369 objects, even though I have only created one variable with the button press (froggers) and no new nodes are being created. 

This does NOT (from what I tested atleast) happen if the string is not in a rich text label, which is strange.

I will try and see if I can find the problem later today, but that's what I have for now.

### Steps to reproduce

func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
	var froggers: String = "frog"
	for i in 5000:
		$RichTextLabel.text = $RichTextLabel.text + "\n" + froggers

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[stringtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20280870/stringtest.zip)
